logline: A scholarship student at an elite academy accidentally breaks a priceless vase and must repay the debt by joining an all-male host club, blurring class lines and identity in equal measure.

renewal.note: The 26-episode single season completed its run on September 26, 2006. No sequel series has been produced, though the manga concluded in 2011.

bollymeter.basis: A perennial fan favourite with an 8.1 on IMDb and elevated user scores across major anime databases; praised for sharp parody of shojo tropes, genuine comedic timing, and comparatively inclusive handling of identity for a 2006 production.

seasons.review_body: Bones delivered a reverse-harem comedy in 2006 that earned a reputation for being strange and extremely funny in equal measure. Directed by Takuya Igarashi, the show deconstructs shojo conventions with genuine wit - the host club format is both the premise and the target of its own jokes. Haruhi's class-outsider perspective grounds the absurdity, and the ensemble comedic chemistry registered strongly in audience reception (IMDb: 8.1). The parody of otaku culture earned commendation in multiple outlet reviews. Modern reappraisals have noted that some character depictions carry complications from their 2006 context, though audience scores across databases remain elevated. A 26-episode single-season run that earns its laughs through character rather than situation alone.
